_doc: MCP servers exposed to Zeno's agent. Reference env vars with ${VAR_NAME} — secrets live in .env. Use _disabled: true to keep an entry but skip it. Servers with unresolved env vars are silently skipped at boot (with a warning log).

playwright._comment: Browser automation. No credential needed. Docs: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp

linear._comment: Linear (issues, projects, cycles). Get API key at https://linear.app/settings/api

notion._comment: Notion (databases, pages, blocks). Create an integration at https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations and share pages with it

sentry._comment: EXAMPLE — Sentry error tracking. Set _disabled: false and add SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN to .env to enable. Docs: https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-mcp

cloudflare._comment: EXAMPLE — Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, etc. Set _disabled: false and add CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to .env. Docs: https://github.com/cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare

vercel._comment: EXAMPLE — Vercel deployments and projects. Set _disabled: false and add VERCEL_TOKEN to .env. Docs: https://vercel.com/docs/mcp
